Title: Diagnosis of test `testLANG571` failure in `ArrayUtilsAddTest`

Details:
The test `testLANG571` checks if adding a null element (`aString=null`) to a null array (`stringArray=null`) using `ArrayUtils.add` results in throwing an `IllegalArgumentException`. The test expects that this operation should not be allowed and should throw that specific exception. 

The relevant method under test is `ArrayUtils.add(T[] array, T element)`:
- If the array is not null, it assigns `type = array.getClass()`.
- Else if the element is not null, it assigns `type = element.getClass()`.
- Otherwise, it assigns `type = Object.class`.
- Then a new array is created with size increased by 1 using the `copyArrayGrow1` method.
- The element is set at the last position of the new array.
- The new array is returned.

When both `array` and `element` are `null`, the method sets the component type of the new array to `Object.class` (line 3295), then proceeds to create a new array of length 1 of type `Object[]` (inside `copyArrayGrow1`). Finally, it assigns `null` to position 0 of this new array and returns it.

Since the method does not throw any exception in this case, the test's expectation to catch `IllegalArgumentException` fails, leading to the test failure.

Thus, the core problem is the lack of validation for the case when both the input array and element are null, where the method should ideally throw `IllegalArgumentException` but currently it does not.

Suggested fix:
Add a check in the `add` method to throw an `IllegalArgumentException` when both parameters `array` and `element` are null, before attempting to create a new array.

Methods to be fixed:
- org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayUtils.add(T[], T)

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
